## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **On-Site Fuel Supply & Diesel Logistics:** 24/7 bulk diesel delivery, dedicated fuel bowsers, jobsite equipment and generator fueling with zero project downtime across Riyadh and KSA.
2. **Full Fleet Vehicle Rental & Heavy Machinery Hiring:** Comprehensive hire of hydraulic crawler excavators (20T-45T), heavy dump trucks and tippers (16m³-32m³), 3-ton dynas and pickups, lowbed trailers, and mobile cranes (25T-100T) with certified operators.
3. **Civil & Structural Contracting:** Turnkey General Contracting, Reinforced Concrete Footings & Superstructures, Insulated Masonry & Block Work, Villa construction, road building, and structural renovations.
4. **Building Envelope & Façade Engineering:** Unitized & Stick Curtain Walls, Spider Glass Façade Systems, Fire-Rated Aluminum Composite Panels (ACP), and Waterproofing/Thermal Insulation.
5. **MEP Engineering:** HVAC Central Plants, Low-Voltage Electrical Distribution Panels, Low-Current Cabling, Water Supply & Drainage Networks, and SMACNA Ducting.
6. **Finishing & Turnkey Fit-Out:** False Ceilings, Drywall Partitions, Architectural Coatings & Epoxies, Natural Marble & Porcelain Tile Flooring, and Corporate Office Fit-outs.
7. **Earthworks & Site Logistics:** Bulk Deep Excavation, Hydraulic Rock Breaking, Laser Grading & Compaction, and Hoarding Setup.
8. **Industrial & Facility Operations:** Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB), Industrial Warehouse Construction, and Civil Facility Maintenance.

## Standards & Compliance
- Full adherence to the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and SASO standards.
